description: Gearshift chooses the model and reasoning effort for bounded-context subagent spawns using the OpenAI Decisions API under the user's own API key. PreToolUse is synchronous and may add model and reasoning_effort to spawn_agent arguments; it changes nothing else unless convert_full_forks is enabled. PostToolUse is asynchronous and record-only. Both exit 0 on any failure and never block a spawn. Only the subagent's task prompt (truncated) and agent type are sent; no diffs, files, or parent transcript.

hooks.statusMessage: Gearshift is choosing a model for this subagent
